programs.desc: USA meets Bosnia and Herzegovina in a Round of 32 game of the FIFA World Cup in San Francisco. USA finished first despite a 2-3 loss to Türkiye in the final Group D match. Bosnia and Herzegovina ranked third in Group B after a 3-1 win over Qatar.

programs.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programs.desc: The first FIFA World Cup Group H match between Spain and Cabo Verde takes place at Atlanta Stadium. Cabo Verde makes a historic debut by participating in the FIFA World Cup for the first time. Their first game is against the 2024 UEFA Euro champions.

programs.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programs.desc: France faces Spain in a semi-final match of the FIFA World Cup at Dallas Stadium. France beat Morocco 2-0 behind Kylian Mbappe's opener, marking his eighth World Cup goal. Spain defeated Belgium 2-1 after Mikel Merino scored in the 88th minute.

programs.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programs.desc: Mexico faces England in a Round of 16 match of the FIFA World Cup at Mexico City Stadium. Mexico defeated Ecuador 2-0 with goals scored by Raul Jimenez and Julian Quinones. England won against Congo DR 2-1 with both goals scored by Harry Kane.

programs.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programs.desc: France plays England in a Bronze Final match of the FIFA World Cup at Miami Stadium. France play the Bronze Final game after losing 0-2 to Spain in the semi-finals. Anthony Gordon scored the opening goal in England's 1-2 loss to Argentina.
